browserValidation.environment: Codex Desktop 26.715.7063 on Windows using the in-app Chromium browser against the local React Router production build at 127.0.0.1:3030; the automation API did not expose the exact Chromium runtime version. Desktop viewports were 1440x1000 and 1365x900; the mobile viewport was 390x844.
scenarios: Rendered the guides index, all six guide articles, and all eleven contextually linked tool routes in desktop light, desktop dark, mobile light, and mobile dark modes: 72 screenshots, 72 single-H1 checks, and zero document-level horizontal-overflow failures.
Verified all three guide tables remain inside horizontal-scroll wrappers at 390px rather than widening the document.

Rendered all 132 canonical non-redirect routes in Chromium: 132 paths matched, 132 single-H1 checks passed, canonical link metadata was present on every route, and no document-level horizontal overflow or hydration-error text was found.

Ran a three-second countdown, opened a second browser tab, waited 4.3 seconds, and confirmed the countdown reconciled to 0:00 with the Finished state. The automation environment continued to report the countdown page as visible, so this does not simulate operating-system freezing or a physically locked device.
Activated the Online Alarm Clock Test sound control from a user-gesture click and observed no browser warning or error logs.
Changed Speedcubing Timer preferences to Instant toggle and 12 maximum session solves, recorded a solve, reloaded, and confirmed the preferences persisted while the session result cleared.

Entered America/New_York 2026-03-08 02:30 and confirmed the converter rejected the nonexistent spring-forward time; entered 2026-11-01 01:30 and confirmed the earlier-occurrence ambiguity warning plus 2026-11-01T05:30:00.000Z.
Entered 1700000000 seconds, 1700000000000 milliseconds, and 1700000000000000 microseconds in auto-detect mode; all three resolved to 2023-11-14T22:13:20.000Z with the expected unit labels.
Collected warning and error logs after the representative interaction tests and the 132-route sweep; no warnings or errors were reported.
screenshots: Guide and changed-tool matrix: 18 routes x desktop/mobile x light/dark = 72 captured viewport screenshots.
Representative visual inspection: guides index in desktop light and dark.
Representative visual inspection: browser-storage guide in desktop dark and 390px mobile light.
Representative visual inspection: Unix-units guide in 390px mobile dark and DST guide in desktop light.

manualTestRecords.browserVersion: Exact Chromium runtime version not exposed; Codex Desktop build 26.715.7063
manualTestRecords.setup: Production build, three-second countdown, second browser tab available.
steps: Entered 0 minutes and 3 seconds, applied the value, and started the countdown.
Opened the background-timer guide in a second tab and waited 4.3 seconds.
Read the countdown route state after the wait.
manualTestRecords.observedResult: The countdown displayed 0:00 and the Finished state.
manualTestRecords.limitations: The automation environment continued to report the countdown page as visible, so this did not reproduce operating-system page freezing, device sleep, or a physically locked phone.

manualTestRecords.browserVersion: Exact Chromium runtime version not exposed; Codex Desktop build 26.715.7063
steps: Located the Test sound control from the rendered accessibility tree.
Clicked Test sound as a user gesture.
Collected browser warning and error logs.
manualTestRecords.observedResult: The control executed and no warning or error logs were reported.
manualTestRecords.limitations: Automation cannot confirm that a person heard audio through the speakers or reproduce every mute, silent-mode, output-routing, or background policy.

manualTestRecords.browserVersion: Exact Chromium runtime version not exposed; Codex Desktop build 26.715.7063
manualTestRecords.setup: Production build with an empty session.
steps: Selected Instant toggle and set the maximum session solves to 12.
Started and stopped a solve to create a session result.
Reloaded the route.
manualTestRecords.observedResult: Instant toggle and the 12-solve preference persisted; the session result cleared and the empty-session message returned.
manualTestRecords.limitations: This proves the tested preference/session distinction in one Chromium profile; it does not prove indefinite retention in private browsing or after site-data clearing.

manualTestRecords.browserVersion: Exact Chromium runtime version not exposed; Codex Desktop build 26.715.7063
manualTestRecords.setup: Production build with America/New_York as the source zone and Europe/London as the destination.
steps: Loaded 2026-03-08 02:30 through deterministic route parameters.
Loaded 2026-11-01 01:30 through deterministic route parameters.
Read the rendered status and ISO output after client hydration.
manualTestRecords.observedResult: The spring time was rejected as nonexistent; the fall time was labeled as occurring twice, selected the earlier occurrence, and produced 2026-11-01T05:30:00.000Z.
manualTestRecords.limitations: Results use the IANA timezone data supplied by this runtime and do not prove every browser or future timezone-rule update.

manualTestRecords.browserVersion: Exact Chromium runtime version not exposed; Codex Desktop build 26.715.7063
steps: Entered 1700000000000000 and compared the rendered unit labels and ISO values.
manualTestRecords.observedResult: The inputs were labeled seconds, milliseconds, and microseconds respectively; all three resolved to 2023-11-14T22:13:20.000Z.
manualTestRecords.limitations: The test covers the production thresholds and example range, not every negative, fractional, or out-of-Date-range value.

manualTestRecords.browserVersion: Exact Chromium runtime version not exposed; Codex Desktop build 26.715.7063
manualTestRecords.setup: Production build at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 in light and dark modes.
steps: Rendered the guide index, six guide articles, and eleven changed tool pages in each viewport and theme combination.
Captured 72 viewport screenshots and checked H1 count and document width.
Inspected the three mobile guide tables for scroll containment.
manualTestRecords.observedResult: All 72 renders had one H1 and no document-level horizontal overflow; all three tables stayed inside horizontal-scroll wrappers.
manualTestRecords.limitations: This visual matrix covers the recorded Chromium environment, not Safari, Firefox, physical phones, or assistive-technology combinations.

manualTestRecords.browserVersion: Exact Chromium runtime version not exposed; Codex Desktop build 26.715.7063
steps: Loaded every non-redirect canonical path from the route architecture manifest.
Checked final path, one H1, canonical link presence, document overflow, and hydration-error text.
Collected warning and error logs after the sweep.
manualTestRecords.observedResult: 132 of 132 paths matched with one H1, canonical metadata, no document overflow, no hydration-error text, and no warning or error logs.
manualTestRecords.limitations: The sweep verifies the local production build in one Chromium runtime and does not replace deployed monitoring or cross-browser testing.

limitations: The automation environment cannot reproduce physical device lock, operating-system sleep, browser process discard, or every background-throttling policy.
The sound control executed without console errors, but automation cannot confirm that a human heard audio through the machine's speakers.
The automation API did not expose the exact Chromium runtime version; the host Codex Desktop build is recorded instead.
This pass used the in-app Chromium browser; Firefox, Safari, mobile browser shells, and assistive-technology combinations were not independently exercised.
Corrupt or inaccessible localStorage fallback is covered by source review and automated safeguards rather than by mutating browser storage during this visual pass.
